original_test_intent: Verify TEMP_MB_CPU0 and TEMP_MB_CPU1 identity, description, reading, units and health consistently across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web, with each resource bound to the correct motherboard CPU socket and approved SPEC.
original_method: Prove IB/OOB/Web target identity, collect full unfiltered SDR and Sensor lists through both command paths within an approved interval, capture both complete Web rows, map CPU0/1 to installed sockets, normalize fields and compare to the SPEC without clearing evidence or modifying SDR or thermal controls.
manual_activity: A platform reviewer approves the CPU0/CPU1-to-socket map and sensor SPEC, visually confirms both Web rows, and adjudicates bounded cross-view differences.
required_inputs: Reviewed private Script revision or equivalent
safety_requirements: Do not change thresholds, fan policy, power or configuration
Verify socket mapping and same target
Reject stale, missing or duplicate resources
agent_execution_scope: Collect full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Normalize per-CPU identity, description, reading, units, state, thresholds and timestamps
Apply approved socket map and tolerance
engineer_actions: Approve socket map, SPEC and field normalization
Visually confirm Web rows and page context
Resolve missing, swapped or divergent CPU resources

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `sensor get 'TEMP_MB_CPU0~1'` treats a two-member label as one literal resource, and one OOB read plus truncated SDR does not cover IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and Web.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture complete unfiltered lists on both verified paths and both explicit CPU resources in Web; normalize them against the socket map inside the approved time/load window.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All five source-required views and two sensors remain; 3/3 minutes are preserved as metadata, while grep-only, truncation and generic clearing are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a two-row evidence matrix keyed by physical socket, attaching all five representations, capture timestamps, load context and SPEC result to each socket.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic two-member enumeration, physical socket identity and temporal/load controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A swapped CPU label or stale Web cache can show plausible temperatures while associating health with the wrong socket.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Sequential values need not be identical under changing load; only project-approved time and temperature deltas are valid.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define installed socket population, CPU0/CPU1 mapping, canonical fields, units, range, refresh window and allowed delta. The private Script requires a pinned reviewed revision before use.
expected_evidence: SUT/BMC/firmware identity and IB/OOB/Web same-target proof
Installed CPU topology, CPU0/1 socket map and approved SPEC
Both protected Web rows with filter/pagination/refresh context
Credential-redaction, no-mutation/no-log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently require two CPU sensors across five views. Generic clearing and DeepSeek's incomplete literal-range command are method defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Socket mapping, parsers, protected access and SPEC are identifiable package inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED only if a required view or CPU identity remains unresolved after obtaining them.

review_improvement: Restores two-sensor completeness, socket identity and all five interfaces, preventing one literal OOB query from falsely satisfying CPU thermal parity.
independent_technical_reasoning: Two CPU sockets can run different workloads and thermal policies, so similar values do not prove correct labeling. Because IPMI and Web paths may refresh asynchronously, reliable parity requires physical socket binding plus timestamp/load-aware comparison of complete source sets rather than literal equality or output order.
